verdict.rationale: Calendly's own docs describe a personalized scheduling link and booking page that syncs multiple calendars and checks for conflicts before someone books. Community users confirm invitees pick a slot from the link with no back-and-forth email threads. One user reported that the availability shown is sometimes inaccurate, which tempers confidence in how live it is but does not refute the capability. Missing for 10: in-depth first-party documentation of how quickly calendar sync updates the live availability shown on the booking page.

support.subject: As a founder, I can share a booking link where invitees pick a time from my live availability — no back-and-forth email

citations.quote: Personalize your scheduling link and booking page for a more polished experience.
